audience.text: Developers building .NET applications on Windows, Linux, or macOS who need to generate or manipulate Excel-compatible workbooks and PDF reports without requiring Microsoft Excel.

capabilities.text: Create new workbooks or load existing .xlsx files via Workbook constructors, then modify worksheets, cells, and formatting before saving.
capabilities.title: Create and edit workbooks

capabilities.text: Apply fonts, fills, borders, alignment, and number formats to cells using Style, Font, Borders, and FillPattern types, with StyleFlag for selective application.
capabilities.title: Format cells and styles

capabilities.text: Add data validation rules and apply conditional formatting to highlight cells based on values or formulas.
capabilities.title: Validate and highlight data

capabilities.text: Export worksheets to PDF with configurable page layout, orientation, and one-page-per-sheet settings via PdfSaveOptions.
capabilities.title: Export to PDF

capabilities.text: Attempt to repair corrupted or malformed .xlsx files using LoadOptions settings and inspect LoadDiagnostics for repair status and data loss risk.
capabilities.title: Repair malformed files

capabilities.text: Create structured ListObject tables with totals and apply built-in styles, and insert Chart objects using ChartCollection.
capabilities.title: Add structured tables and charts

limitations.text: Load support is limited to XLSX files; legacy formats like XLS, ODS, and CSV are not supported.
Save support is limited to XLSX and PDF; image and HTML export are not available.
The library does not parse, evaluate, or recalculate formulas; Cell.Formula stores only the formula string.
No VBA or macro support; macro-enabled workbooks round-trip only non-macro content.
Pivot tables are not part of the public API surface.
No print execution; PageSetup configures print settings but does not send workbooks to a printer.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and modification of Excel workbooks in server-side or containerized environments where Microsoft Excel is unavailable.
Supports recovery from malformed Excel files via LoadOptions settings, reporting diagnostics and potential data loss risks instead of failing outright.
Provides worksheet-level formatting, styling, validation, conditional formatting, and structured table support for generating consistent, styled reports.
Allows export of workbooks to PDF with configurable page layout and orientation, supporting print-ready document generation.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells.FOSS is a free, open-source .NET library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks and exporting to PDF, with no dependency on Microsoft Excel.

workflows.name: Create and style a workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a new Workbook, add data to Cells, apply Style with Font, Borders, and FillPattern, and save to .xlsx.

workflows.name: Load and repair a malformed workbook
workflows.text: Load a workbook using LoadOptions with TryRepairPackage and TryRepairXml enabled, inspect LoadDiagnostics for repairs or data loss risk, then modify and save.

workflows.name: Export to PDF with page setup
workflows.text: Configure PageSetup for paper size and orientation, then save the workbook to PDF using PdfSaveOptions with OnePagePerSheet.

workflows.name: Apply validation and conditional formatting
workflows.text: Add Validation rules to a range using ValidationCollection, and apply ConditionalFormatting via FormatConditionCollection.

workflows.name: Build structured tables with totals
workflows.text: Create a ListObject from a cell range, enable totals row with TotalsCalculation, and apply built-in TableStyleType.

workflows.name: Add charts and shapes
workflows.text: Insert Chart objects using ChartCollection, and anchor Picture or Shape objects to a worksheet.
